title: Somebody Has Been Awake Up There for 25 Years
description:
Four hundred kilometres above your head there is a room that has never been empty: how people live, sleep and work in orbit.

#shorts #space #iss #orbit

scenes.title: someone is awake up there
scenes.voice: Right now, four hundred kilometres above your head, someone is awake and working. That has been true for twenty-five years.

shots.image_prompt: The Earth seen at night from low orbit, glowing city lights under thin clouds, the black curve of the horizon and a faint blue band of airglow
shots.caption: SOMEONE IS AWAKE

shots.image_prompt: A space station with long gold solar panels drifting over the night side of Earth, its small windows lit warm against the dark
An astronaut in a blue flight suit floating beside a laptop in a cramped module, cables and handrails all around, cool white light

scenes.title: a sunrise every ninety minutes
scenes.voice: The station falls around the planet at nearly eight kilometres a second, so the crew sees a sunrise every ninety minutes.

shots.image_prompt: Sunrise seen from orbit, a blade of orange light along the curved edge of the Earth, the dark truss of the station in the foreground
shots.caption: A SUNRISE EVERY 90 MINUTES

shots.image_prompt: A long exposure photograph of Earth from orbit, city lights drawn into bright streaks beneath the station's gold solar panels
The curved horizon of Earth glowing blue and white beneath a wing of solar panels, deep black space above, hard sunlight

scenes.title: no up and no down
scenes.voice: Inside there is no up and no down. Tools float, water floats, and the sleeping bags are strapped to the wall.

shots.image_prompt: The inside of a station module packed with equipment, cables and handrails, a pen and a notebook caught floating in mid air, cool light
shots.caption: NO UP, NO DOWN

shots.image_prompt: A perfect sphere of water floating in the air of the module, bending the reflection of the astronaut watching it, soft highlights
A sleeping bag strapped upright to a padded wall in a narrow crew cabin, a laptop and taped photographs beside it, dim warm light

scenes.title: one suit, and the vacuum
scenes.voice: Outside, one layered suit is all that stands between a person and the vacuum, and every spacewalk is rehearsed for months.

shots.image_prompt: An astronaut in a white suit tethered to the station truss high above the blue Earth, harsh sunlight on the gold visor, black space behind
shots.caption: ONE SUIT

shots.image_prompt: Close view of a gloved hand gripping a metal handrail on the station hull, the curved Earth reflected in the helmet visor
Two astronauts training underwater in a huge pool beside a full-size mock-up of a station module, safety divers watching nearby

scenes.title: Look up tonight
scenes.voice: Tonight it will cross your sky as a bright, silent point of light. Follow, and I will show you when.

shots.image_prompt: A single bright point of light drawing a straight line across a deep blue night sky above a quiet field, scattered stars, no moon

hud.means: the health of the link with the probe
the delay the film is about
